title: Gallformers import — phase 5 review and phase 6 response
description: The phase 5 check of a package's batches against its document (VERIFY_GUIDE.md), and the producer's phase 6 answer to each finding (PRODUCER_GUIDE.md). Delivered with the package: disputed findings go to a human reviewer at intake.

reviewed.description: The sha256 of each batch file as reviewed in phase 5.

reviewers.description: Who reviewed: one entry per reviewer whose findings are listed.

findings.description: One entry per problem found. Empty when every statement checks out.

id.description: The act, Fact, taxon or Gall the finding is about.

problem.description: unsupported: the evidence does not say it. wrong_value: a controlled value doesn't match its definition or the quote. wrong_type: the wrong Relationship type, act kind or qualifier. wrong_stance: confirm/deny is wrong. wrong_target: the wrong taxon, Gall or generation. rule: a PRODUCER_GUIDE.md rule is broken.

reason.description: What is wrong, citing the document.

suggestion.description: Optional: what the statement should be.

reviewer.description: Which reviewer found it (its model), when several reviewed.

response.description: Phase 6: the producer's answer. agree: the statement was fixed. disagree: the statement stands, and the finding goes to a human reviewer at intake.

reason.description: For agree, what was changed; for disagree, why the statement stands, citing the document or the guide.

responded.description: Phase 6: written once every finding has a response.

result.description: The sha256 of each batch file after the phase 6 fixes.
